headline: Executive order changes the list of officials who would lead the Department of Homeland Security if top leaders are unavailable.
what_it_does: This order updates the order of succession for the Department of Homeland Security. That is the ranked list of officials who would step in to act as Secretary if the Secretary and other top leaders die, resign, or cannot do the job. No summary was provided, so the specific changes to the list are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Senior officials at the Department of Homeland Security
who_it_affects.how: Their place in line to temporarily run the department may change under the updated succession list.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 9, 2016; the source does not state a separate effective date.
